title: Meet “Rhiya Ahir”: The Girl Behind Viral Police Vehicle Stopping Pic Who Posts “Exclusive” Subscription Content
summary: Rhiya Ekousiya, the 27-year-old Mumbai-based model and entrepreneur who became an overnight sensation after blocking a police van during the student-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protests, is now facing scrutiny over her motivations.
